page.layout: One column of an alphabetical index of heresies, each entry followed by its chapter reference (cap.), with letter headings (B, C, D, E, F, G) as separate lines. Running head at top. Bottom: gathering signature at foot left. No page number printed.
page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s. "Chrifti" read as "Christi" from the context of the line. "Florinians" as printed on the scan is uncertain: [?] applies to the printed form, which may read "Floriniani". Signature "ü.iij" is partly obscured; the leading letter may be u or v. Faint show-through from the reverse page (e.g. around "cap.lxxiij" and in the margins) was ignored.
